start.content: I could see the colt between people's shoulders! Then someone lifted a branch and I couldn't see anything. Everyone was shouting.

choices.text: What could you see when the way cleared?
Did you see where the colt came from?

steps.text: I could see the colt between people's shoulders! Then someone lifted a branch and I couldn't see anything. Everyone was shouting.

sight.content: Jesus was riding it. There were clothes on its back, and people were putting more on the road. I kept hoping it wouldn't tread on anyone's sleeve.

steps.text: Jesus was riding it. There were clothes on its back, and people were putting more on the road. I kept hoping it wouldn't tread on anyone's sleeve.

sound.content:
"Hosanna!" I shouted it too. I asked what it meant, but there was so much noise I couldn't hear the answer.
You should ask someone who knows the words. I can tell you how loud we were!

limits.content:
No. I was here, waiting for the procession. Someone told me about the men fetching it, but I didn't see that part.
Will you put down the bit I really saw?

choices.text: Yes. Tell me about the cloaks.

closing.content:
Remember the clothes on the road. I saw those myself.
I only saw a little of it. But I was there.
